title: codex-qa findings
description: Response shape for a QA delegation. Passed to `codex exec --output-schema`; the model's final message conforms to this instead of to prose instructions.

scope_covered.description: Repo-relative paths actually read. Not the paths requested — the paths reached.

findings.description: Defects found. Empty is a valid answer; do not pad.

file.description: Repo-relative path. Must be a file you actually read.

trigger.description: The concrete input or state that reaches the defect. Not a category of input — a specific one, precise enough to write a test from.

result.description: What actually goes wrong when the trigger fires.

covered_by.description: Path (and test name) of the existing test that would catch this, or null when nothing covers it.

severity.description: high: data loss, corruption, or silent wrong results. medium: failure the user sees and cannot work around. low: recoverable or narrow.

unspecified_behavior.description: Places where correct behavior is genuinely undefined by spec, tests, or docs — so no defect can be asserted. Report the ambiguity here rather than inventing a bar and filing it as a finding.

notes.description: What limited the pass: files that could not be read, context that was missing, areas deliberately skipped. Empty string if none.
